scripts.check: turbo run typecheck runtime-gate benchmark oxlint format dead-code architecture dedupe workspace-gate --filter=./packages/* --filter=// --continue=dependencies-successful
scripts.check:full: turbo run typecheck --filter=./packages/* --filter=// --continue=dependencies-successful --force -- --incremental false; typecheck=$?; turbo run runtime-gate benchmark oxlint format dead-code architecture dedupe workspace-gate --filter=./packages/* --filter=// --continue=dependencies-successful --force && exit $typecheck
scripts.lint: turbo run oxlint dead-code architecture workspace-gate --filter=./packages/* --filter=//
scripts.ratchet:lower: pnpm --filter effect-openapi-cli-generator run ratchet:lower && node packages/generator/scripts/ratchet.ts dead-code --lower
